coverageNotes: Full manual text is embedded for the commands listed in this library. The cheat sheets also cover tools and platforms without a bundled manual.
Local manuals reflect the jumpbox package versions shown, not necessarily the versions installed on your target images.
MSTFlint manuals describe open-source counterparts of some proprietary MFT commands; their options can differ.

DCGM, proprietary MFT utilities without an open-source counterpart, switch NOS, Windows, macOS, firmware vendor guides, and programming-language handbooks are not included as full manuals. Their existing cheat sheets remain available offline.
InfiniBand manuals are included as expanded upstream text, including shared option sections. Build-time configuration placeholders remain as published.
